features.name: Data Directory

features.evidence: Carried over from P1 -- verified working

features.name: Document Import
features.description: Users can import .txt and .md files via ImportPanel with file picker
features.evidence: Fixed ImportPanel using removed File.path API (now uses webUtils.getPathForFile via preload) and a preload load failure caused by sandbox:true blocking relative requires. Verified end-to-end under Electron with xvfb: file picker import produces a listed document.

features.name: Document Detail with Content
features.description: DocumentDetail shows full document content, metadata, and delete button
features.evidence: Wired up the previously-unused documents:content IPC call so DocumentDetail loads and renders full document text; fixed broken relative import paths to shared/types that failed tsc. Verified metadata, content, and delete render correctly via Electron screenshot test.

features.name: Basic Persistence
features.description: Imported documents persist across app restarts via filesystem storage
features.evidence: Verified via Node smoke test that re-instantiates PersistenceService/DocumentService/IndexingService/QaService against the same data directory (simulating a restart): document metadata, content, chunks, and Q&A history all persist correctly.
